notes: EasyCard works on the MRT, buses and YouBike. Eating and drinking are banned on the MRT (you will be fined). The MRT to Taoyuan Airport takes 40 minutes.

Summer brings 33°C heat and humidity, and July to September carries a typhoon risk (everything closes under a T8 signal). Sightsee in the morning, visit museums or malls in the afternoon, and go to night markets in the cooler evening.
Night markets run 18:00-24:00, and 300 TWD is enough to eat your fill. Tipping is not expected, and cash is still widely used.
For Jiufen, Shifen and Yehliu, take a tour (~1,500 TWD) or bus 1062. Go to Jiufen in the afternoon, as the lanterns light up after 17:00.
Take a queue number at Din Tai Fung. Noodles at Yongkang and Lin Dong Fang cost 250 TWD.
You do not take your shoes off in temples. Divination blocks and incense are open to all.

transit.name: EasyCard
transit.why_chosen: Works on the MRT, buses, YouBike and in convenience stores, including the Jiufen bus

stops.name: Taipei 101 Observatory
stops.tips: Floor 89. The first slot in the morning is uncrowded. Look for the wind damper ball.

stops.name: Xinyi District
stops.tips: Shopping malls and the Eslite bookstore, all air-conditioned.

stops.name: Din Tai Fung Xinyi
stops.tips: The brand that made xiaolongbao (soup dumplings) famous. Take a queue number at 11:45.

stops.name: Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall
stops.tips: Changing of the guard every hour. The park has views of Taipei 101.

stops.name: Elephant Mountain
stops.tips: A steep 20-minute staircase climb. The sunset photo of Taipei 101 is crowded but worth it.

backups.name: Kao Chi Yongkang
backups.tips: A cheaper rival to Din Tai Fung, serving xiaolongbao.

backups.name: Songshan Cultural Park
backups.tips: Design exhibitions in an old tobacco factory.

stops.name: National Palace Museum
stops.tips: Imperial Chinese treasures, including the Jadeite Cabbage and the Meat-shaped Stone, Tuesday to Saturday. Go before the morning tour buses arrive.

stops.name: Shilin Official Residence
stops.tips: The gardens of Chiang Kai-shek's residence, with a rose garden.

stops.name: Lin Dong Fang Beef Noodle
stops.tips: Some of the best beef noodle soup in Taipei (Bib Gourmand), with a clear broth.

stops.name: Beitou Thermal Valley
stops.tips: A steaming green hot spring lake with a sulphur smell. Take the MRT to Xinbeitou.

stops.name: Beitou Public Hot Spring
stops.tips: A public hot spring (60 TWD, swimwear required), shared with locals.

backups.name: Shilin Night Market
backups.tips: Taipei's biggest night market, known for giant fried chicken cutlets and stinky tofu.

backups.name: Beitou Hot Spring Museum
backups.tips: A Japanese-era bathhouse building, good for a rainy day.

stops.name: Yehliu Geopark
stops.tips: See the Queen's Head rock and the mushroom rocks. Arrive before the tour buses.

stops.name: Shifen Waterfall
stops.tips: Known as Taiwan's Niagara. A 20-minute walk.

stops.name: Shifen Old Street
stops.tips: Release a sky lantern over the railway tracks (150 TWD) and watch the trains pass.

stops.name: Jiufen Old Street
stops.tips: A terraced mountain town with taro balls and tea houses, and a Spirited Away feel.

stops.name: A-Mei Tea House Jiufen
stops.tips: A tea house hung with red lanterns. Come for the oolong and the view; the lanterns light up at sunset.

backups.name: Houtong Cat Village
backups.tips: A cat village, as an alternative to Shifen.

stops.name: Longshan Temple
stops.tips: Taipei's oldest temple. Come in the morning for prayers, incense and divination blocks.

stops.name: Bopiliao Historic Block
stops.tips: A Qing-era street with a free exhibition.

stops.name: Dihua Street
stops.tips: Dadaocheng's street of dried goods and tea, with Baroque facades and a Lunar New Year market.

stops.name: Yongle Market Food Court
stops.tips: Local food in the Dadaocheng market. Try the oyster omelette.

stops.name: Dadaocheng Wharf
stops.tips: Riverside container bars, with sunset views and cycling.

backups.name: Ximending
backups.tips: Taipei's Shibuya, with youth culture and street art. A swap for the wharf.

stops.name: Yangmingshan Qingtiangang
stops.tips: Grassland and water buffalo above the city. Cool in summer. Take bus 260.

stops.name: Xiaoyoukeng
stops.tips: Sulphur fumaroles and views of Qixing Mountain.

stops.name: Yangmingshan Zhuzihu
stops.tips: Calla lily fields and a village restaurant.

stops.name: Yangmingshan Kalla Restaurant
stops.tips: Mountain vegetables and chicken in Zhuzihu.

stops.name: Raohe Night Market
stops.tips: A single-street night market. The charcoal-baked pepper buns (Fuzhou pepper buns) are at the entrance.

stops.name: Tamsui Old Street
stops.tips: At the end of the MRT line, an estuary town known for a-gei (stuffed tofu) and fish balls.

stops.name: Fort San Domingo
stops.tips: A Dutch-Spanish fort and British consulate. Look for the red building.

stops.name: Tamsui A-Gei Restaurant
stops.tips: Glass noodles stuffed in tofu, Tamsui's signature dish.

stops.name: Fisherman's Wharf Tamsui
stops.tips: Lovers' Bridge. Cross by ferry; there are cafes on the pier.

stops.name: Tamsui Sunset Beach
stops.tips: Home to some of Taiwan's most famous sunsets, over the estuary.

backups.name: Bali Left Bank
backups.tips: The opposite bank by ferry, with a cycle path.

stops.name: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall
stops.tips: A giant white monument with a changing of the guard every hour. Liberty Square is out front.

stops.name: Yongkang Street
stops.tips: Cafes and mango shaved ice. Try Smoothie House.

stops.name: Yongkang Beef Noodle
stops.tips: Serving braised beef noodles since 1963. A good farewell lunch.

stops.name: Da'an Forest Park
stops.tips: A city forest for a last walk. The MRT to Taoyuan Airport takes 40 minutes.

backups.name: Smoothie House Yongkang
backups.tips: Mango snow ice, a dessert in place of noodles.

backups.name: Taipei Botanical Garden
backups.tips: Lotus ponds, as a swap for the park.
